name: Zap Attack!
review:
Aliens on a 5x5 grid with 25 lines. Expanding multiplier wilds up to x5 can cover whole reels, and the bonus upgrades symbols into high-pays.

When a couple of those multiplier wilds line up on the same spin, things can jump quickly. The symbol upgrades in the bonus make every hit count for more. High volatility, 5,000x cap, 96.15% RTP. Light, colourful sci-fi fun with more bite than it looks.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
